notes.text: 17 fakta, sumber BBC/Computerworld/WaPo/Wikipedia. Biaya global >US$300 mlr (IDC 308), 2038: 19 Jan 2038 03:14:07 UTC -> 1901. Engine: audira-2d-motion (Remotion 2D, mograph look), project dari starter AUDIRA-SKILL-MOTION (script sfx/render:final).
